explanation: He was about 1.7 m (roughly 5 feet 7 inches), average or a little above. British cartoons mocked him as tiny, and French inches, longer than English ones, added to the confusion.

claims.text: At about 1.7 m, Napoleon was not unusually short for a Frenchman of his time.
Napoleon was about 1.7 m tall, roughly 5 feet 7 inches.
Napoleon's height was about average, or slightly above average, for French men of his era.
British cartoonists such as James Gillray often drew Napoleon as tiny.
His height was recorded as 5 feet 2 inches in French units, and the French inch (pouce) was longer than the English inch, so the figure sounded short to English readers.
